title: Jolli Integration
content:
## Overview

The project includes an integration with Jolli. Details of the integration's functionality are not yet documented here.

## Local State Handling

Local Jolli integration state is excluded from version control via `.gitignore` (or equivalent ignore configuration). This means:

- Any files generated or maintained locally as part of the Jolli integration (e.g., credentials, caches, sync state) are not tracked by git.
- Developers should not expect this state to be shared or persisted across clones/checkouts.
- Each environment/machine maintains its own local Jolli integration state independently.

## Rationale

Ignoring local integration state keeps machine-specific or sensitive/transient Jolli data out of the repository, preventing accidental commits of local-only artifacts.
